# Globals register (generated by tools/globals_census.py)

Every `global` declared in the scanned LiveCode (1225 distinct script files). 498 globals; 416 follow the owner's naming (`gWhatIsIt`, or `bWhatIsIt` for a boolean: "ok (b)"), 82 do not (proposed name given; "leftover?" = a `t`/`p` name declared global, which by the owner's prefixes (t temporary, p parameter) is a debugging leftover: drop the global declaration and see what breaks). Python is the equivalent type in `python/lib_globals.py`, judged from use: indexed -> dict, set to true/false -> bool, arithmetic -> float, else str. "W/R" = lines writing / reading it. Purpose: the comment beside its declaration where there is one; the rest is to be written (in `PURPOSES.md`, which this tool merges in). GAD = owner / type / content in the owner's GAD_Globals register (165 globals there, 164 of them declared in the scanned scripts; "(rule)" = the stack's default, not a saved value); its comment is the purpose of last resort.
